example: My purse is full of receipts pretending to be money.

example: My wallet gets thinner whenever I visit the bakery.

example: Mum's handbag contains everything except the thing she wants.
translation: Onamning sumkasida u izlayotgan narsadan boshqa hamma narsa bor.

translation: Soyabonim teskariga ag‘darilib, yomg‘ir uchun kosaga aylandi.

translation: Charm etiklarim o‘zimni muhim ko‘lmaklarga tayyordek his qildiradi.

translation: Bu jinsi kurtka uchta egasi va bitta kuchukchadan omon qolgan.

translation: Mato gilos rasmlariga to‘la, shuning uchun uni mevali ko‘ylagim deyman.

example: My sleeve reached the soup before my spoon did.
translation: Yengim sho‘rvaga qoshig‘imdan oldin yetib bordi.

example: Dad straightened his collar to answer a phone call.

example: The cuff of my shirt has collected half my breakfast.
translation: Ko‘ylagimning manjeti nonushtamning yarmini yig‘ib olgan.

example: My hood keeps the rain out and my hairstyle secret.
translation: Kapyushonim yomg‘irni to‘sadi va soch turmagimni sir saqlaydi.

example: The coat has a bright pink lining that nobody expects.
translation: Paltoning hech kim kutmagan yorqin pushti astari bor.

translation: Bitta qizil chiziq bu paypoqlarni kutilmaganda sportcha ko‘rsatadi.

example: My waterproof jacket works, but my trousers are having a bath.

translation: Ko‘zga tashlanadigan shimimga biroz osoyishtalik berish uchun gulsiz ko‘ylak oldim.

translation: Bu kurtka menga ham, tushligimga ham torlik qiladi.

translation: Tugma tika olaman, lekin u yangi tomonga qarab qolishi mumkin.

example: The receipt is longer than the scarf I bought.
translation: Xarid cheki olgan sharfimdan ham uzunroq.

example: I got a refund for the kettle that refused to boil water.
translation: Suv qaynatishni istamagan choynak uchun pulimni qaytarib oldim.

translation: Chegirma menga kerak bo‘lmagan shlyapani sotib olishga undadi.

translation: Chegirmali savdoga bitta ko‘ylak uchun borib, beshtasi bilan qaytdim.

translation: Barcha tugmalarini tuzatishga pul bergunimcha bu palto yaxshi arzon xarid edi.

translation: Kassada aynan sut uchun kelganimni esladim.

translation: Kassir zarurat uchun olgan shokoladlarimga to‘la savatimga qarab jilmaydi.

translation: Deyarli bir xil oltita krujkani solishtirayotgan yagona xaridor men edim.

translation: Eng qisqa navbatga turdim va u darhol yurmay qoldi.

translation: Kiyib ko‘rish xonasi men sinayotgan paltodan ham kichikroq.

translation: Yorliqda qo‘lda yuving deyilgan, demak bu jemper talabchan.

example: I wore the new shirt with the tag still waving behind me.
translation: Yangi ko‘ylakni osma yorlig‘i orqamda hilpiragan holda kiyib yurdim.

example: I forgot the brand but remembered the biscuit flavour.
translation: Mahsulot markasini unutdim, ammo pechenye ta’mini eslab qoldim.

example: The parcel arrived, and the cat claimed the box first.
translation: Jo‘natma keldi va mushuk qutini birinchi bo‘lib egalladi.

example: The package is huge, but the earrings inside are tiny.
translation: Qadoq ulkan, ammo ichidagi sirg‘alar mitti.

example: My latest purchase is a spoon shaped like a little shovel.
translation: Eng so‘nggi xaridim kichkina belkurak shaklidagi qoshiq.

example: My order includes six towels because guests keep appearing.
translation: Mehmonlar kelaverayotgani uchun buyurtmamga oltita sochiq kiritdim.

example: The delivery came while I was wearing my least serious pyjamas.
translation: Buyurtma eng kulgili pijamamni kiyib turganimda yetkazib berildi.

example: The shop has plenty of stock, except for my size.
translation: Do‘konda mahsulot ko‘p, faqat mening o‘lchamim yo‘q.

example: The boots are available in every colour except the one I want.
translation: Etiklar men xohlaganidan boshqa barcha rangda mavjud.

example: I will try on the hat before giving it such a serious job.
translation: Shlyapaga shunday jiddiy vazifa berishdan oldin uni kiyib ko‘raman.

example: The shopkeeper knows I always return for more biscuits.
translation: Do‘kondor yana pechenye uchun qaytishimni biladi.

example: The soap slipped away as if it also disliked washing.
translation: Sovun ham yuvinishni yoqtirmagandek sirg‘alib ketdi.

example: This shampoo promises shiny hair, but mine remains independent.
translation: Bu shampun yaltiroq sochni va’da qiladi, ammo mening sochim o‘z bilganidan qolmaydi.

example: The conditioner helped my comb travel through my hair peacefully.
translation: Soch balzami tarog‘imning sochim orasidan tinchgina o‘tishiga yordam berdi.

example: I squeezed the toothpaste and decorated the basin by mistake.
translation: Tish pastasini siqib, bilmasdan yuz-qo‘l yuvgichni bezadim.

example: My electric toothbrush sounds more awake than I feel.
translation: Elektr tish cho‘tkam mendan ko‘ra uyg‘oqroq ovoz chiqaradi.

example: The floss found a popcorn piece that wanted to stay overnight.
translation: Tish ipi tunab qolmoqchi bo‘lgan bodroq bo‘lagini topdi.

example: Dad packed his razor but forgot his shirts.
translation: Dadam ustara joyladi, lekin ko‘ylaklarini unutdi.

example: This comb has a difficult meeting with my hair every morning.
translation: Bu taroq har tong sochim bilan qiyin uchrashuv o‘tkazadi.

example: My hairbrush is hiding because it knows how I slept.
translation: Soch cho‘tkam qanday uxlaganimni bilgani uchun yashirinib olgan.

example: The hairdryer gives me warm air and a very large hairstyle.
translation: Fen menga issiq havo va juda katta soch turmagi beradi.

example: I remembered my deodorant just before a very crowded bus ride.
translation: Juda gavjum avtobusga chiqish oldidan dezodorantimni esladim.

example: Her perfume entered the room a second before she did.
translation: Uning atiri xonaga o‘zidan bir soniya oldin kirdi.

example: This lotion smells like coconut, so my hands feel on holiday.
translation: Bu losondan kokos hidi keladi, shuning uchun qo‘llarim ta’tildagidek.

example: My hands are so dry that they seem to drink the moisturiser.
translation: Qo‘llarim shunchalik quruqki, go‘yo namlantiruvchi kremni ichayotgandek.

example: I put on sunscreen before my nose turns into a tomato.
translation: Burnim pomidorga aylanmasidan oldin quyoshdan himoya kremi surtaman.

example: A tissue in my pocket survived everything except the washing machine.
translation: Cho‘ntagimdagi salfetka kir yuvish mashinasidan boshqa hamma narsadan omon qoldi.

translation: Gigiyenik paxta hammom tokchasidagi mitti bulutga o‘xshaydi.

example: The nail clippers are tiny, which makes losing them very easy.
translation: Tirnoq olgich mitti, shu sababli uni yo‘qotish juda oson.

translation: Tirnoq egovim tirnoqlarimning mitti ilgaklarga aylanishiga yo‘l qo‘ymaydi.

example: I found the tweezers after giving up on my stubborn eyebrow.

example: My lipstick left a red hello on the white cup.
translation: Lab bo‘yog‘im oq piyolada qizil salom qoldirdi.

translation: Kiprigimga tush surtdim va darhol aksirgim keldi.

example: My make-up took twenty minutes, but washing it off took two.

translation: Juda ko‘p vanna ko‘pigi qo‘shib, tizzalarimni ko‘rmay qoldim.

translation: Budilnigim meni ayblab turganida sekin kiyinaman.

example: Put on your slippers; the floor is colder than your ice cream.
translation: Shippagingizni kiying, pol muzqaymog‘ingizdan ham sovuqroq.

example: Apply a little cream; your face is not a birthday cake.
